decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric close to the firm's existing design and application knowledge, it is still visible in 2024 and can likely be refined through normal collection learning rather than removed.

This decorative semi-transparent fabric fits the firm's established interior-textile capabilities, and continued website presence suggests enough market relevance to justify keeping it while learning from customer response.
Its continued stand-alone presentation plus strong fit with the firm's functional curtain expertise, especially flame-retardant contract use, make it highly likely to remain in the range.

Although a wool-blend decorative fabric is somewhat more niche and less aligned with the firm's sustainability simplification goals, it still builds on familiar design and material knowledge and remains marketable.

This fabric is specialized but still closely related to the firm's decorative textile know-how, so management would more likely keep it and use accumulated collection knowledge to improve positioning than drop it immediately.
As a newly launched 2024 product with its own page and clear overlap with both upholstery and curtain competences, it is too early and too well aligned with existing capabilities to discontinue soon.
